description: Implement new specialized models: Form-Adjusted Model, Logistic Regression Model, and Monte Carlo Simulation per design.md sections 5.7-5.9
steps: Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\form_adjusted.py implementing FormAdjustedModel per design.md section 5.7 - uses time-decayed form features to adjust Poisson lambdas
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\monte_carlo.py implementing MonteCarloSimulation per design.md section 5.9 - generates match outcome distribution through repeated simulation
Refactor c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\logistic_regression.py to implement PredictionModel interface per design.md section 5.8
Register all 3 new models in model_registry.py with proper metadata
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\tests\test_form_adjusted.py testing form weight calculations, time decay, insufficient data handling
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\tests\test_monte_carlo.py testing simulation convergence, deterministic seeding, probability distribution
acceptance_criteria: FormAdjustedModel correctly applies time-decayed form weights to base predictions
MonteCarloSimulation produces stable probability distributions (10000+ iterations)
LogisticRegression properly handles missing features and returns ModelAvailability when insufficient
All 3 models return ModelAvailability (not exceptions or fake data) when data insufficient
All 3 models expose proper metadata via get_metadata()
Models registered in ModelRegistry and retrievable by ID
Test coverage >85% for all 3 new model files
verification: cd c:\FootballIntelligence\backend && python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short (all tests pass)
